subject.title: [Bug]: Browser composite waits and nested batches time out before all steps can finish

question: Should the Browser owners sponsor the bounded recursive watchdog-budget fix now under the protected maintainer workflow?
rationale: The defect and repair boundary are technically clear, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit owner decision before implementation intake.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded fix
options.body: Implement the shared recursive budget resolver with parity tests and live Browser proof, without adding configuration or changing action ordering.

options.title: Defer with ownership
options.body: Keep the issue open and assign an owner or milestone if the Browser timeout work should wait for a broader `/act` reliability pass.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded fix
